🛠️ What users are telling Product Product

Top recurring asks & notable bugs from ambassadors, internal testers & closed-beta F&F — the direct product-input pipe for R1
Impact: real testers surface what to fix and build next before wider launch — every item below feeds the R1 roadmap. Full item-by-item log (172 entries) in the Feedback & Bugbash Tracker →
💡 Top feature / UX asks≈130 logged
• Sorting in Markets — by price, trending, market cap & max leverage 4+ testers
• Chart timeframes beyond 1D — 1W / 1M / 1Y for basic TA
• PNL clarity & sharing — show value not just %, net-of-fees PNL, shareable PNL card
• Easier Sell / close — Sell buried behind the position sheet; add it beside Buy
• More top-up options & localization — fiat beyond USD, local currencies, language support
• Watchlist / favorites toggle · swap function · guest mode to lower entry barrier
🐞 Notable bugs (P0/P1)41 logged
• Perps order fails — "order couldn't be placed" & can't open a 2nd position (CA-798/799)
• Can't close a position — but can still add to it; being root-caused with Product
• Top-up / card / Apple & Google Pay failures — incl. Korea; no bank-side alert
• PNL misleads — Realized PnL shown gross of fees; users think they profited while losing
• Chart / timeframe switch freezes app ~5–6s; crypto charts slow to load
• Wrong token news mapping (meme→XRP, META→MRK) · deposit text cut off (iPhone XS Max)

💬 How the launch is landing Marketing

Overall Day-1 read from the closed beta group · brand-mood signal, not the product backlog
Impact: a live pulse on how R1 is received by an influential, crypto-native audience — useful for launch messaging & timing decisions.
🙂 Positive
Testers are enjoying the app — smooth onboarding, fast OCW ↔ Cronos switching, and near-instant trade fills draw the most praise. Multiple unprompted "buttery smooth · overall experience has been good" reports. One P1 in flight: a can't-close-a-position bug is being actively root-caused with Product.
⚡ Instant fills 🔁 OCW ↔ Cronos switching ✅ Smooth onboarding 🧼 Clean, simple UI 👍 "Buttery smooth"
🧠 Audience skews highly crypto-native — most questions & conversations lean technical (wallet addresses, block explorer, transaction hashes, etc.).

Grassroots Events Playbook (Ambassador-Led)Playbook
How ambassadors run small, community-first local events — a concept ladder with budget bands and 50%-upfront funding for credible hosts. Every event can bolt on a reusable "onboarding corner" for app downloads + waitlist/F&F signups.

ConceptWhat it isBudget
Partner & community eventsPlug into an existing community's meetup as a guest segment, or co-host with another project / local community.$0–100
University / education talkInvited educational talk at an institution-run event, using a talking-point template to stay within legal parameters.$100–250
Casual community meetupAmbassador hosts once the local community reaches ~80–100 members; expect ~25–30% turnout.$500–800
